digest.component_or_area: tickets store fetch and CI checkout
propositions: fresh full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall time; --filter=blob:none reduces to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (~15x faster)
CI tickets fetch in actions/checkout step takes 237s versus 2s for manual worktree mount, representing 92% of job wall time
when tickets remote fetch times out, rebar silently bootstraps orphan branch with empty store instead of failing closed, diverging from origin/tickets and returning empty reads

blob:none partial clone preserves complete commit graph for merge-base and ancestry scoping while removing lazy blob fetches, safe for rebar verify-identity access patterns that read bodies from working tree
gerrit-verify.yaml verify-identity job performs full-history fetch explicitly rejecting --depth, subject to same 1.4 GB / 51.5k-commit clone cost as reconcile-bridge.yml
